Compensating Differentials of Rents, Wages and Agricultural Returns: The Quality of Life among Indonesian Regencies and Cities
abstract: It has long been challenging to assess local residents’ quality of life, which is affected by numerous natural and man-made amenities. We develop a novel compensating differential model of quality-of-life rankings applicable to developing countries by introducing farm income into the household budget alongside housing and labour market differentials. We apply this model to Indonesia using detailed household data from the Indonesian Family Life Survey for two different time periods and combining estimates of agricultural, off-farm labour and housing market differentials. We find heterogeneous amenity impacts across the agricultural and off-farm labour sectors. We use our model to show how significant changes in rankings across time are consistent with contemporaneous internal migration patterns in Indonesia. These rankings yield important information for policymakers on expected changes in migration and can be used to help inform public investment.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，评估当地居民的生活质量一直颇具挑战，因为生活质量受众多自然与人为便利设施的影响。我们提出了一种适用于发展中国家的新型补偿性差异生活质量排序模型，在住房和劳动力市场差异之外，将农业收入纳入家庭预算约束。我们利用印度尼西亚家庭生活调查（IFLS）的详细家庭数据，针对两个不同时期将该模型应用于印度尼西亚，并综合估计了农业、非农劳动和住房市场的差异。我们发现，便利设施对农业部门与非农劳动部门的影响存在异质性。我们利用该模型表明，两个时期之间排序的显著变化与印度尼西亚同期的国内人口迁移格局相一致。这些排序为政策制定者提供了关于未来人口迁移变化的重要信息，并可用于为公共投资决策提供参考。

A Flood of Construction: The Role of Levees in Urban Floodplain Development
abstract: We estimate the effect of leveerelated flood-risk reduction on rates of new housing development. Using a fixedeffect Poisson regression and a nonlinear difference-in-differences identification strategy, we find that newly constructed levees increased the rate of residential development by more than 50% compared with areas without levee protection. Contemporary analysis using a duration model indicates effects lasting decades later, with the magnitude of the induced development attenuating over time. Our findings inform discussion of the "levee effect" and highlight the possibility that further flood-risk reduction investment in levees may be partially offset through increased development activity.(JEL R31, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们估计了堤防相关的防洪风险降低对新住房开发速度的影响。采用固定效应泊松回归和非线性双重差分识别策略，我们发现，与没有堤防保护的地区相比，新建堤防使住宅开发速度提高了50%以上。采用持续时间模型的当代分析表明，其影响可持续数十年，但诱发开发的规模随时间推移而减弱。我们的发现为“堤防效应”的讨论提供了信息，并强调了一种可能性：对堤防进行的进一步防洪风险降低投资，可能会因开发活动增加而部分抵消。（JEL R31, Q58）

Stocks, Flows, and Flood Insurance: A Nationwide Analysis of the Capitalized Impact of Annual Premium Discounts on Housing Values
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) is chronically insolvent due to the increased intensity and frequency of natural disasters. NFIP was not designed to be actuarially sound; however, the increasing debt associated with NFIP has resulted in policy efforts to increase flood insurance premiums. Despite widespread concerns over the affordability of higher premiums, less attention has been paid to the impact of premium rate increases on housing values and associated homeowner wealth. We use the quasi-experimental nature of eligibility criteria for the largest class of flood insurance premium discounts to causally estimate the capitalization of flood insurance premium subsidies using nationwide and city-specific hedonic difference-in-difference regressions. We find that in a nationally pooled sample, the average capitalization of subsidy eligibility is $11,807 and show that capitalization exhibits significant and intuitive heterogeneity across municipalities. Our results inform ongoing policy discussions surrounding the planned transition to NFIP’s Risk Rating 2.0 premium schedule.
abstract_zh: 国家洪水保险计划（NFIP）由于自然灾害强度和频率的增加而长期资不抵债。NFIP的设计并非精算稳健的；然而，与NFIP相关的债务不断增加，促使政策努力提高洪水保险保费。尽管人们普遍担心更高保费的可负担性，但保费上涨对房屋价值及相关房主财富的影响却较少受到关注。我们利用洪水保险最大类别保费折扣资格标准的准实验性质，通过全国范围和城市特定的特征价格双重差分回归，因果估计了洪水保险保费补贴的资本化效应。我们发现，在全国合并样本中，享受补贴资格的平均资本化金额为11807美元，并表明资本化在各城市之间表现出显著且直观的异质性。我们的结果为围绕NFIP向“风险评级2.0”保费方案转型的持续政策讨论提供了信息。

title: The Impact of Deforestation on Nature-Based Recreation: Evidence from Citizen Science Data in Mexico
abstract: We use citizen science eBird data to investigate the effect of deforestation on birdwatching across Mexico. Using detailed data on individual trips reported to eBird, we construct annual count data on visits to 1, 810 Mexican municipalities from 2008 to 2016 to examine how deforestation affects visitation patterns. We find that a municipality, experiencing an increase in deforestation equivalent to the average deforestation over our study period, would see birdwatching visits decrease by 4.4% a year. The results also provide an application of citizen science data using an underused source of information on economic behavior in an otherwise limited data environment.
abstract_zh: 我们利用公民科学的eBird数据，考察森林砍伐对墨西哥各地观鸟活动的影响。利用报告至eBird的个人出行详细数据，我们构建了2008年至2016年间1810个墨西哥市镇访问量的年度计数数据，以考察森林砍伐如何影响访问模式。我们发现，若某一市镇的森林砍伐增量等于本研究期间的平均森林砍伐量，则其观鸟访问量每年将减少4.4%。研究结果还展示了如何在数据其他方面较为有限的环境中，利用一种未被充分利用的经济行为信息来源来应用公民科学数据。

Missing the Forest for the Trees: Balancing Shale Exploration and Conservation Goals through Policy
abstract: Unconventional shale gas activity has presented both challenges and opportunities for conservation. The unique nature of horizontal drilling used in shale exploration allows for a reduction in the footprint of shale‐related activity in the landscape. However, existing policies regulating shale activity across the Northeast, particularly in Pennsylvania, largely miss an opportunity to encourage such consolidation, which would result in substantial ecosystem conservation. Using satellite land cover data for the years 2006 and 2011 combined with data on shale drilling activity in Pennsylvania, we show that a consolidation of wells to underutilized well pads would have resulted in a forest conservation gain of over 112,838 acres between 2006 and 2015. While likely an overestimate, this suggests that small changes in policy such as moving toward a quantity‐based market mechanism to regulate the number of well pads would result in substantial conservation gains.
abstract_zh: 非常规页岩气活动为保护工作既带来了挑战，也带来了机遇。页岩勘探所用水平钻井技术的独特性质，使得页岩相关活动在景观中的占地面积得以减少。然而，东北部地区（尤其是宾夕法尼亚州）现行的页岩活动监管政策，在很大程度上错失了鼓励这种集约化的机会，而集约化本可带来可观的生态系统保护效益。利用2006年和2011年的卫星土地覆盖数据，并结合宾夕法尼亚州的页岩钻井活动数据，我们发现，若将井位集中到利用不足的井场，2006年至2015年间可实现超过112838英亩的森林保护收益。虽然这很可能是高估的，但这表明，政策上的小幅调整（例如转向以数量为基础的市场机制来规范井场数量），将带来可观的保护收益。

title: Not My Problem: Growth Spillovers from Uncoordinated Land Use Policy
abstract: Land use policy is administered at the local level in the U.S. However, many of the benefits and costs have broader spatial impacts. Thus, a lack of coordination across local jurisdictions may lead to unintended spillovers. Using historical data from the Baltimore, Maryland metro, we examine the impact that an extensive zoning policy change in Baltimore County had on new housing supply in surrounding counties. Defining treatment and control locations in surrounding counties based on their adjacency to Baltimore County, we find that the change in zoning policy led to an increase in housing supply of 42%-97% in adjacent counties. In both spatial and temporal falsification tests, we fail to find evidence of a spillover effect suggesting that the increased development was likely the result of spillovers from uncoordinated policy.
abstract_zh: 在美国，土地利用政策由地方层面管理。然而，许多收益与成本具有更广泛的空间影响。因此，地方司法辖区之间缺乏协调，可能会导致意想不到的外溢效应。利用马里兰州巴尔的摩都会区的历史数据，我们考察了巴尔的摩县一项大范围分区政策变化对周边各县新住房供给的影响。根据周边各县与巴尔的摩县的毗邻关系来界定处理组和对照组，我们发现，分区政策的变化使毗邻各县的住房供给增加了42%至97%。在空间和时间的证伪检验中，我们均未发现存在外溢效应的证据，这表明增加的开发很可能是不协调政策外溢的结果。

title: The Effects of Adaptation Measures on Hurricane Induced Property Losses
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Federal government spends millions of dollars after major disaster declaration to help disaster impacted communities recover. Without empirical evidence, we can say little about how effective these disaster related programs are in terms of promoting local resilience. The paper employs control function approach of endogeneity to investigate public adaptation effects on hurricane induced property losses. A percent increase in FEMA investment in hazard mitigation and public assistance programs reduces per capita property losses by 0.16%. The conditional elasticity of damage associated with the projects related to disaster warning and awareness studies were estimated at around 0.13%. Similar elasticities were estimated for projects related to improvements in major structural and infrastructural projects as well as in-response clean-up and debris removal programs funded through FEMA. While the results indicate that FEMA should be indifferent allocating resources across competing activities, current US disaster policy seems to be more reactive rather than being proactive, capping the spending on ex-ante mitigation programs at 15% of the total FEMA spending.
abstract_zh: 联邦政府在发生重大灾害宣布后投入数百万美元，帮助受灾社区恢复。若缺乏实证证据，我们对这些灾害相关计划在促进地方韧性方面的成效知之甚少。本文采用内生性控制函数方法，考察公共适应措施对飓风引起的财产损失的影响。FEMA在减灾和公共援助计划中的投资每增加1%，人均财产损失减少0.16%。与灾害预警和宣传研究相关项目的有条件弹性估计约为0.13%。在与主要结构和基础设施改善项目，以及由FEMA资助的应急清理和碎片清除计划相关的项目中，也估计出了类似的弹性。虽然结果表明FEMA在各竞争性活动之间分配资源应当无差异，但当前美国灾害政策似乎更偏向于被动应对而非主动预防，并将事前减灾计划的支出限制在FEMA总支出的15%。

title: Changes in U.S. Consumer Response to Food Safety Recalls in the Shadow of BSE
Does Extreme Weather Drive Interregional Brain Drain in the U.S.? Evidence from a Sorting Model
abstract: Previous studies have identified mean temperature as an important factor in household location choice, but no study has measured the impact of extreme weather on U.S. interregional brain drain. We estimate a residential sorting model to examine the effects of extreme weather on heterogeneous household location choices across the United States. We find that college graduates are more sensitive to extreme temperatures and are willing to pay more than other demographic groups to avoid hot weather. In light of predicted increases in extreme heat days in the West and Southwest, these areas may be at risk of significant human capital loss. (JEL Q51, Q54)
abstract_zh: 既往研究已将平均气温确定为家庭居住地选择的重要因素，但尚无研究衡量极端天气对美国区域间人才外流的影响。我们估计了一个居住分类模型，以考察极端天气对美国各地异质性家庭居住地选择的影响。我们发现，大学毕业生对极端气温更为敏感，并且比其他人口群体更愿意支付更高的费用以避开炎热天气。鉴于西部和西南部地区极端高温天数预计将增加，这些地区可能面临重大人力资本流失的风险。（JEL Q51, Q54）

title: Evading Invasives: How Eurasian Water-Milfoil Affects the Development of Lake Properties
Maintaining Public Goods: The Capitalized Value of Local Park Renovations
Unconventional Shale Gas Development, Risk Perceptions, and Averting Behavior: Evidence from Bottled Water Purchases
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Advances in technology have made extraction of natural gas from deep shale formations economically viable. While unconventional shale gas development is seen as an economic benefit, concerns have been raised about the environmental and health risks associated with the extraction process. We combine GIS data on unconventional shale gas development in Pennsylvania and Ohio with household data on bottled water purchases to assess the impact that perceived risks to drinking water from unconventional shale development have had on household well-being using a triple difference treatment effects design. In our preferred triple difference models with time-varying treatment effects, we find per-household averting expenditure in 2010 ranges from 10.74 in our full sample specification to $15.64 when omitting urban counties more likely to contain public water supplies. Converting the sample-average averting expenditure of $10.74 to an annual expenditure for the entire impacted population implies an averting expenditure in Pennsylvania shale counties exceeding $19 million for the year 2010.
abstract_zh: 技术进步使得从深层页岩地层中开采天然气在经济上具有可行性。尽管非常规页岩气开发被视为一种经济利益，但人们也对开采过程中可能带来的环境和健康风险表示担忧。我们将宾夕法尼亚州和俄亥俄州非常规页岩气开发的GIS数据，与家庭瓶装水购买数据相结合，采用三重差分处理效应设计，评估非常规页岩开发对饮用水的感知风险给家庭福利带来的影响。在我们偏好的、具有时变处理效应的三重差分模型中，我们发现2010年每户家庭的规避支出，在完整样本设定下为10.74美元，而在剔除更可能拥有公共供水系统的城市县之后则高达15.64美元。将样本平均规避支出10.74美元换算为整个受影响人口的年度支出，意味着2010年宾夕法尼亚州页岩县的规避支出超过1900万美元。

title: Does Organic Command a Premium When the Food is Already Local?
Equilibrium Sorting Models of Land Use and Residential Choice
abstract: Equilibrium sorting models of household location choice provide a framework for understanding the interactions among people, markets, and spatially delineated amenities. Sorting models begin by characterizing the spatial landscape and household preferences. Utility-maximizing location choices are expressed as a function of the characteristics of people, houses, and communities, as well as of structural parameters describing latent preferences. This relationship is then inverted, using the logic of revealed preference to characterize the distribution of household preferences for amenities. Estimation results are used to calculate the willingness to pay for changes in landscape amenities and to predict how people and markets will adjust to counterfactual policies. This chapter aims to make sorting models accessible to economists who are new to the literature and to clarify their connection to the reduced form models of hedonic equilibria that have traditionally been used for “back of the envelope” policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 家庭居住地选择的均衡分类模型提供了一个框架，用以理解人口、市场与空间界定的舒适性（amenities）之间的相互作用。分类模型首先刻画空间景观和家庭偏好。效用最大化的位置选择被表示为人的特征、住房与社区特征，以及描述潜在偏好的结构参数的函数。随后利用显示性偏好的逻辑对该关系进行反演，以刻画家庭对舒适性偏好的分布。估计结果用于计算景观舒适性变化的支付意愿，并预测人口与市场将如何对反事实政策做出调整。本章旨在使刚接触该文献的经济学者能够理解分类模型，并阐明其与传统上用于“信封背面”式政策分析的享乐均衡简化式模型之间的联系。

title: Is the Shale Boom a Bust for Nearby Residents? Evidence from Housing Values in Pennsylvania
abstract: Profitable extraction of previously inaccessible shale energy reserves has led to the rapid expansion of shale exploration across the United States. We present one of the first empirical studies to measure the impact of early shale exploration on surrounding homeowners using data from Washington County, Pennsylvania, from 2008 to mid 2010. We find that property values are negatively impacted by shale gas exploration activity, but this impact depends on the proximity and intensity of shale activity and is largely transitory. The negative effects are larger for households located close to major highways and sourced with private well water.
abstract_zh: 页岩能源储量的盈利性开采，导致页岩勘探在美国各地迅速扩张。我们提出了最早的一批实证研究之一，利用宾夕法尼亚州华盛顿县2008年至2010年年中的数据，衡量早期页岩勘探对周边房主的影响。我们发现，页岩气勘探活动会对房产价值产生负面影响，但这一影响取决于页岩活动的邻近程度和强度，并且在很大程度上是暂时的。对于位于主要高速公路附近以及使用私人井水的家庭，负面效应更大。

title: Measuring Price Elasticities for Residential Water Demand with Limited Information
abstract: This paper exploits the seasonal and annual changes in marginal prices for water to estimate the price elasticity of demand by residential households for water. It uses the changes in distributions of water using the census block group levels in response to changes in marginal prices of water for matched months across years. This strategy reduces the interaction effects of outdoor use and demographic fact in determining responsiveness to price. By comparing years that vary in overall water availability the framework can recover measures of how responses to price vary with season and draught conditions. The application is the urban Phoenix metropolitan area.
abstract_zh: 本文利用家庭用水边际价格的季节性和年度变化，估计居民家庭对水的价格弹性。它利用人口普查街区组层面用水分布的变化，来回应跨年份匹配月份中边际水价的变化。这一策略减弱了户外用水与人口统计特征的交互效应对价格反应的影响。通过比较总体水资源可得性不同的年份，该框架能够恢复价格反应如何随季节和干旱条件变化的衡量指标。应用案例为凤凰城大都市区。
